nodes.description: Public string state variable 'name' holding the token name, set once in the constructor.
Public string state variable 'symbol' holding the token ticker, set once in the constructor.
Public uint8 state variable 'decimals' holding token decimals (18), set in the constructor.
Public uint256 state variable '_totalSupply' holding the initial total supply of 1e27 tokens.
Private mapping(address => uint) 'balances' tracking token balance per account; written by constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
Private nested mapping 'allowed' storing ERC20 allowances owner=>spender=>amount; written by approve and transferFrom.
Constructor: initializes name, symbol, decimals, _totalSupply and credits the whole supply to msg.sender.
public view totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply minus the balance of address(0), computed with a plain unchecked subtraction.
public view balanceOf(address tokenOwner): returns balances[tokenOwner].
public view allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
public approve(address spender, uint tokens): sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval; no return-value check by callers.
public transfer(address to, uint tokens): subtracts tokens from balances[msg.sender] via safeSub and adds them to balances[to] via safeAdd, then emits Transfer.
public transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): debits balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender] and credits balances[to] using safeSub/safeAdd, then emits Transfer.
SafeMath helper safeAdd(uint a, uint b): computes c = a + b and requires c >= a to catch overflow.
SafeMath helper safeSub(uint a, uint b): requires b <= a then computes c = a - b to catch underflow.
SafeMath helper safeMul(uint a, uint b): computes c = a * b and requires a == 0 || c / a == b to catch overflow.
SafeMath helper safeDiv(uint a, uint b): requires b > 0 then computes c = a / b.
msg.sender referenced in the constructor to receive the entire initial supply (sender of the deployment transaction).
msg.sender used in approve() as the owner key of the allowed mapping.
msg.sender used in transfer() as the account debited by safeSub.
msg.sender used in transferFrom() as the spender whose allowance in allowed[from][msg.sender] is decremented.
Arithmetic write balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens) inside transfer(); underflow guarded only by the SafeMath require.
Arithmetic write balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) inside transfer(); overflow guarded only by the SafeMath require.
Arithmetic write balances[from] = safeSub(balances[from], tokens) inside transferFrom(); underflow guarded only by the SafeMath require.
Arithmetic write allowed[from][msg.sender] = safeSub(allowed[from][msg.sender], tokens) inside transferFrom(); allowance decrement relying on safeSub.
Arithmetic write balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) inside transferFrom(); overflow guarded only by the SafeMath require.
Parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf(address tokenOwner), used as the key into the balances mapping.
Parameter tokenOwner of allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender), first key into allowed.
Parameter spender of allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender), second key into allowed.
Parameter spender of approve(address spender, uint tokens), second key into allowed.
Parameter tokens of approve(address spender, uint tokens), the allowance amount written.
Parameter to of transfer(address to, uint tokens), recipient credited via safeAdd.
Parameter tokens of transfer(address to, uint tokens), amount moved between balances.
Parameter from of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens), owner debited.
Parameter to of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens), recipient credited.
Parameter tokens of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens), amount moved and allowance decrement.
Parameter a of SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b).
Parameter b of SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b).
Parameter a of SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b).
Parameter b of SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b).
Parameter a of SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b).
Parameter b of SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b).
Parameter a of SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b).
Parameter b of SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b), required to be > 0.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns the literal token name to the name state variable.
Constructor assigns the literal token symbol to the symbol state variable.
Constructor sets decimals = 18.
Constructor initializes _totalSupply to 1000000000000000000000000000.
Constructor reads msg.sender to determine the initial token holder.
msg.sender is used as the mapping key when balances[msg.sender] is set to _totalSupply.
totalSupply() reads _totalSupply to compute the returned value.
totalSupply() reads balances[address(0)] in an unchecked subtraction from _totalSupply.
balanceOf() returns balances[tokenOwner].
allowance() returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approve() reads msg.sender as the allowance owner.
msg.sender indexes the owner dimension of allowed when writing the new allowance.
approve() writes the tokens amount into allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transfer() reads msg.sender as the sender whose balance is debited.
msg.sender indexes balances for the debit operation in transfer().
transfer() writes the updated sender and recipient balances into the balances mapping.
transfer() performs the unchecked-in-logic subtraction balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens).
transfer() performs the unchecked-in-logic addition balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens).
safeSub result is stored back into the balances mapping for the sender.
safeAdd result is stored back into the balances mapping for the recipient.
transfer() calls SafeMath.safeSub for the sender balance debit.
transfer() calls SafeMath.safeAdd for the recipient balance credit.
transferFrom() reads msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is decremented.
transferFrom() writes updated balances[from] and balances[to] into the balances mapping.
transferFrom() writes the decremented allowance into allowed[from][msg.sender].
msg.sender indexes the spender dimension of allowed during the allowance decrement.
transferFrom() performs balances[from] = safeSub(balances[from], tokens), guarded only by the SafeMath require.
transferFrom() performs allowed[from][msg.sender] = safeSub(allowed[from][msg.sender], tokens).
transferFrom() performs balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens), guarded only by the SafeMath require.
safeSub result is stored back into balances[from].
safeSub result is stored back into the allowed mapping for the spender.
safeAdd result is stored back into balances[to].
transferFrom() calls SafeMath.safeSub for the balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom() calls SafeMath.safeAdd for the recipient balance credit.
tokenOwner parameter is the lookup key used by balanceOf().
tokenOwner parameter is the first lookup key used by allowance().
spender parameter is the second lookup key used by allowance().
spender parameter is written as the allowance key in approve().
tokens parameter is the allowance amount written in approve().
to parameter is the recipient key credited in transfer().
tokens parameter is the amount debited/credited in transfer().
from parameter is the owner key debited in transferFrom().
to parameter is the recipient key credited in transferFrom().
tokens parameter is the amount moved and the allowance decrement in transferFrom().
Parameter a is the first addend of safeAdd.
Parameter b is the second addend of safeAdd.
Parameter a is the minuend of safeSub.
Parameter b is the subtrahend of safeSub checked by require(b <= a).
Parameter a is the first factor of safeMul.
Parameter b is the second factor of safeMul.
Parameter a is the dividend of safeDiv.
Parameter b is the divisor of safeDiv, required to be greater than zero.

normalization_plan.reason: The tokenOwner parameter has no independent state; it only exists as the lookup key consumed by balanceOf, so it folds into the balanceOf function node.
tokenOwner is a transient lookup key for allowance(); it carries no standalone semantics and merges into the allowance function node.
spender is a transient second lookup key for allowance() and merges into the allowance function node.
The spender argument only parameterizes the allowance write performed by approve() and merges into that function.
The tokens argument is the value written by approve() and has no independent identity, so it merges into the approve function node.
The to argument is only the recipient key of transfer()'s balances write and merges into the transfer function node.
The tokens argument is the amount consumed by transfer()'s safeSub/safeAdd operations and merges into the transfer function node.
The from argument is only the debited owner key used by transferFrom() and merges into the transferFrom function node.
The to argument is only the credited recipient key of transferFrom() and merges into the transferFrom function node.
The tokens argument is the operand of the allowance-decrement unsafe operation in transferFrom() and therefore folds into that unsafe_operation node.
Parameter a of safeAdd is a pure arithmetic operand with no independent state and merges into the safeAdd function node.
Parameter b of safeAdd is a pure arithmetic operand with no independent state and merges into the safeAdd function node.
Parameter a of safeSub is a pure arithmetic operand checked by require(b <= a) and merges into the safeSub function node.
Parameter b of safeSub is a pure arithmetic operand compared against a and merges into the safeSub function node.
Parameter a of safeMul is a pure arithmetic operand with no independent state and merges into the safeMul function node.
Parameter b of safeMul is a pure arithmetic operand with no independent state and merges into the safeMul function node.
Parameter a of safeDiv is a pure arithmetic operand with no independent state and merges into the safeDiv function node.
Parameter b of safeDiv is only the divisor guarded by require(b > 0) and merges into the safeDiv function node.
